name: OpenXRay
description:
OpenXRay is an improved, open-source game engine port of GSC Game World's X-Ray Engine. It modernizes the engine powering the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. trilogy (Shadow of Chernobyl, Clear Sky, and Call of Pripyat).

Features:
- Native 64-bit Linux port supporting modern hardware architectures
- Advanced visual renderer supporting DirectX 11 / OpenGL shaders and dynamic lighting
- Substantial performance optimizations and fixes for engine crashes and memory leaks
- Full compatibility with official S.T.A.L.K.E.R. game assets and community modifications
- Enhanced audio backend with 3D positional audio and environmental effects
